name: KV-cache graph_color oracle-search fast screen
purpose: Record the faster KV-cache graph_color mechanism screen requested after the revised full matrix proved too slow. This item adds and uses oracle_search arms where branch and backtrack choices are supplied by the external CSP/oracle, so the run measures restore mechanism and context-cost behavior without model JSON generation or fallback pollution. The execution uses Qwen/Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507, fp32, batch=1, direct Transformers, no vLLM, with v14/v16 complete n=24 bins and a smaller v18 n=8 harder-bin probe.

provenance.execution: Direct Transformers batch=1 shards on CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,1,2,3; v14/v16 n=24 complete, v18 n=8 probe after v18 n=24 preflight proved slow.

code_added_used.change: Adds *_oracle_search arms. Branch and backtrack are chosen by the external CSP/oracle; A_cache still feeds and crops the live model cache, while B_textual and C_incontext account for prompt/context tokens without generation.
Merges shard and checkpoint outputs across difficulty bins and recomputes solve_by_R, decision_quality, fallback_rate, context_vs_depth, A_vs_C_by_depth, tokens, and fork_verdicts.
Adds a lightweight status helper for revised/fast KV-cache graph_color sweeps without jq or rg.

commands.command: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 PYTHONPATH=/tmp/reasoning_benchmarks/reasoning-gym .venv/bin/python -m analysis.kvcache_graph_color_search --output results/kvcache_graph_color/oracle_search_smoke/smoke.json --checkpoint-path results/kvcache_graph_color/oracle_search_smoke/smoke_checkpoint.json --km3-real-prompt results/kvcache_exactness/km3_real_graph_color_prompt_qwen3_fp32.json --model Qwen/Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 --seed 42 --scan-limit 500 --n-instances 1 --min-backtracks 4 --node-cap 240 --num-vertices 14 --num-colors 3 --edge-probability 0.4 --difficulty-bin-label smoke_v14_p04 --order-mode degree_desc --r-values 8,16 --arms A_cache_oracle_search,C_incontext_oracle_search,B_textual_oracle_search --call-cap 120 --max-new-tokens 8 --device cuda --dtype fp32 --invalid-branch-mode fail --invalid-backtrack-mode fail
commands.purpose: Smoke test the oracle_search fast path before launching the matrix.

commands.command: For bins v14_p04 and v16_p04, run four shards on GPUs 0-3 with --n-instances 24 --scan-limit 5000 --node-cap 400 --r-values 0,8,16,32 --arms A_cache_oracle_search,C_incontext_oracle_search,B_textual_oracle_search --call-cap 480 --max-new-tokens 8 --device cuda --dtype fp32 --invalid-branch-mode fail --invalid-backtrack-mode fail, then merge shard JSONs.
commands.purpose: Run complete fast oracle_search mechanism screens for v14/v16 bins.

commands.command: After v18_p04 n=24 preflight selection proved slow, stop only project-owned v18 runners and run v18_p04_n8 with four shards, --n-instances 8 --scan-limit 1500 --node-cap 300 and the same oracle_search arms/R values, then merge with v14/v16 into results/kvcache_graph_color/oracle_search_fast_bins/merged_fast_oracle.json.
commands.purpose: Add a small harder-bin probe without continuing the slow full v18 preflight.

headline.single_next_move: Use oracle_search as the fast restore/context-cost mechanism screen. Do not claim A beats C on solve rate; if a full v18 bin is needed, reuse selected instances or preflight once before sharding.

gate_outcomes.number: Search arms remain gated on results/kvcache_exactness/km3_real_graph_color_prompt_qwen3_fp32.json with status KVCACHE_REAL_PROMPT_KM3_PASS.

decision.next_step_routing: Bank Item104 as a clean, fast mechanism/cost screen: A_cache does not show solve-rate advantage over C_incontext under oracle_search, but it avoids append-only context growth by 28x-43x at solving thresholds. For full harder-bin statistics, reuse selected instances or run preflight once before sharding; for internalization, use this as restore/cost evidence rather than model-decision evidence.

honesty.does_not_establish: This item does not establish that A_cache solves more instances than C_incontext, nor does it measure learned model branch/backtrack decision quality. The branch and backtrack choices are oracle-supplied by design.
honesty.fallback_limit: The oracle_search arms intentionally bypass model JSON generation. This removes parse/fallback pollution, but it also means decision_calls=0 and fallback_rate=None are mechanism-screen facts, not model competence facts.
honesty.context_metric_limit: Token accounting compares incremental cache feed/crop for A against refeeding textual/context prompts for B and C. It supports a context-cost claim, not an end-to-end latency claim under every serving stack.
honesty.v18_limit: The full v18 n=24 run was stopped because repeated shard preflight selection was the bottleneck. The final merged harder-bin evidence is the complete v18_p04_n8 probe.
honesty.next_fix: If a full v18 or larger harder-bin table is needed, precompute/reuse selected graph_color instances before sharding. Keep model-decision quality separate from restore mechanism evidence.
